# House of Bergins — Android theme

Everything here is built from the official assets on houseofbergins.com:
the BERGINS lockup, the BRG monogram, "THE elsewhere COLLECTION" lockup, the paper texture,
the location photography, and the brand fonts (NEXT ART, Typewriter Condensed, Mantreya).
Colours: green `#557352`, ink `#231F20`, ivory `#F5F1E8`.

## What's inside

| Folder | What | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `wallpapers/1440x3200/` | 9 wallpapers, QHD+ | Samsung Galaxy S Ultra / Plus and other QHD phones |
| `wallpapers/1080x2400/` | the same 9, FHD+ | Most other Android phones (Pixel, Galaxy A, etc.) |
| `icons/green/` | 42 app icons + BRG monogram, green | Best on the paper or ivory wallpapers |
| `icons/ivory/` | the same set, ivory | Best on the green or ink wallpapers |
| `widgets/` | 2 wide (4×2) and 2 square (2×2) widget images | Any photo-widget app |
| `preview.png` | How it all looks together | — |

Wallpapers ending in `-lock` keep the logo low so the clock sits on top.
Wallpapers ending in `-home` keep the logo high so your app icons sit below it.
The postcards (Corsica, Kyoto, Muscat), *elsewhere* and *ink* designs work on either screen.

Suggested pairs:
- **Green**: lock `bergins-green-lock` + home `bergins-green-home` + ivory icons
- **Paper**: lock `bergins-paper-lock` + home `bergins-paper-home` + green icons
- **Elsewhere**: lock `bergins-postcard-corsica` + home `bergins-elsewhere` + green icons
- **Dark mode**: `bergins-ink` on both + ivory icons

## 1. Wallpapers (any Android phone)

1. Copy the `wallpapers` folder to the phone (or save the images to your gallery).
2. Open the image in Gallery / Google Photos → ⋮ menu → **Set as wallpaper**.
3. Choose **Lock screen** or **Home screen**, then **Set**.

## 2. App icons

Android's default launcher on most phones doesn't take single custom icons, so use one of these:

**Samsung (One UI)**: install **Good Lock** from the Galaxy Store, open **Theme Park → Icon → Create new**,
then tap each app and pick its PNG from your gallery.

**Any Android phone, with Nova Launcher** (free on Play Store):
long-press an app → **Edit** → tap the icon → **Gallery apps** → pick the matching PNG
(e.g. `instagram.png` for Instagram). For apps not in the set, use `_iconback.png`
(a plain Bergins circle) or the `bergins.png` monogram.

File names match apps: `phone`, `messages`, `contacts`, `camera`, `gallery` (Photos), `browser`, `chrome`,
`playstore`, `settings`, `clock`, `calendar`, `calculator`, `files`, `notes`, `weather`, `maps`, `gmail`,
`email`, `google`, `drive`, `wallet`, `youtube`, `ytmusic`, `spotify`, `whatsapp`, `instagram`, `threads`,
`facebook`, `messenger`, `tiktok`, `snapchat`, `x`, `telegram`, `pinterest`, `netflix`, `shopify`, `amazon`,
`uber`, `paypal`, `zoom`, `claude`, `music`, `bergins` (monogram, for a houseofbergins.com shortcut).

## 3. Widgets

Install any photo-widget app from the Play Store, add its widget to the home screen at the size
shown in the file name (4×2 or 2×2), and pick the image from `widgets/`.

## Fonts

The brand fonts are built into every image. Android doesn't let you set NEXT ART as the system
font on most phones (Samsung only accepts fonts sold in the Galaxy Store), so app labels and
the clock stay in your phone's own font.
